description: A small FM oscillator with feedback, usable as a VCO or an LFO, every instance carrying its own slight detune and its own noise floor

params.text: Multiplies the frequency by two raised to its setting, -4 to +4, for dialling an FM ratio
Raises the pitch in whole semitones, 0 to 12
Shifts the pitch in whole octaves, -5 to +5
Sets how far the FM input moves the phase, 0 to 1
Sets how much of the output is folded back into its own phase, which adds harmonics to the sine

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, 1V per octave; its channel count sets the polyphony
Attenuates the FM input, 10V passing it at the depth the DEPTH knob sets and 0V removing it
Attenuates the feedback, 10V passing the amount the FEEDBACK knob sets and 0V removing it
The signal that modulates the phase, plus or minus 5V for the full depth

outputs.text: The oscillator, plus or minus 5V before the scale and offset in the menu

menu: Output DC Offset — a slider adding -10V to +10V to the output
Scale — a slider multiplying the output by -2 to +2
Unison — a slider trading polyphony for detuned copies of the voice, 1 to 16, summed down to one channel
Over Sample Rate — a slider running the oscillator at 1 to 8 times the sample rate, which keeps the feedback and the FM from aliasing
Default Tuning — sets what 0V at V/OCT means, choosing between Audio C4 at 261.63Hz, Clock / Lfo 2Hz and Slow Lfo 0.125Hz
